levels.note: formulaone0 is a TCP password gate (port 4091) with a byte-by-byte compare whose oracle is the recv() BLOCK: a wrong byte gets an immediate 'WRONG PASSWORD' while a correct byte leaves the daemon blocked reading the next one (no response in 1.5 s). Scanning the alphabet position by position yields the 32-char password in ~32x70 connections. The trailing-'a' artefact past position 32 is the spawned shell swallowing extra bytes (password length found by the scan stopping at 32 with the full string then spawning a shell). Through the dup2-ed /bin/sh: id = uid 20000(formulaone0); cat /etc/formulaone_pass/formulaone0 = the same string = the SSH login password for formulaone0 on port 2232. Verified by ssh login (uid=20000). Recording: recordings/formulaone/L0.cast. Files: tools/formulaone/l0/ (solve.py).

levels.note: Classic access()/open() TOCTOU (same family as Leviathan L2): access(argv[1],R_OK) is evaluated as formulaone0 while open() runs as formulaone1 via setuid, so a path that is readable at access() time and points at /etc/formulaone_pass/formulaone1 at open() time leaks the password. The winning racer: parent does unlink+symlink(decoy,target), forks a child that atomically renames a password symlink onto target, and a second child that execs the binary on target; the pipe is drained to EOF (the first version misclassified partial decoy reads like 'r' as hits). C-speed toggle hits at ~iter 2122; the bash ln-loop never won. Password lyRzImzq8DFfsDJEhGRIqc71CVqipvxo verified by ssh login as formulaone1 (uid=20001). Recording: recordings/formulaone/L1.cast. Files: tools/formulaone/l1/ (racer.c).

levels.note: formulaone2 (setuid formulaone2) invents /tmp/tmp_XXXX (26^4 = 456976 possibilities), requires stat(name)!=0, then fopen(name,"r") and cats it. Attack: pre-create 456,975 of the names as symlinks to /etc/formulaone_pass/formulaone2 (1M free inodes on tmpfs - enough), leaving ONE hole; the binary spins in the stat loop (all other names exist) and returns the hole within ~1M fast iterations. A toggle loop flips the hole between absent and a password symlink: when the stat loop observes it absent but fopen sees the symlink, the setuid binary reads the password and fwrites 256 bytes (33-byte fgets + uninitialized tail). Fork-per-round with WNOHANG watch: a round where fopen hit the DOWN state segfaults harmlessly. Password Bf125B7St83elbZFOoXpp0FKprbD1hZP verified by ssh login as formulaone2 (uid=20002). Recording: recordings/formulaone/L2.cast. Files: tools/formulaone/l2/ (attack.c).

out: shmget(keys[argv[1][0]&3], 8192, IPC_CREAT|0777); shmat(SHM_EXEC) = RWX
if(echo->sz) if(echo->sz < sizeof(buf)) { puts; memcpy(buf, echo->ptr, echo->sz); puts }
DISASM: echo->sz is LOADED TWICE - once for the cmp 0xff check (0x80491e2)
and again for the memcpy size (0x8049205) - a double-read race window
spanning the puts() call. GNU_STACK RW, no canary in the plain binary.

steps.cmd: attack.c: create the 0777 shm; toggler flips sz 10 <-> 0x400;
out: payload at shm+4: 1KB of 'A' + ret-slot dword at +0x110 = shm_base+0x200
shellcode at shm+0x200: open/read/write /etc/formulaone_pass/formulaone3
fork the setuid binary per round; when the check sees 10 but memcpy sees
0x400, 1KB smears the stack and doecho returns into the RWX shm
GOTCHA: pass the key as 0xADC00ADC - strtoul base 0 parses 'ADC..' as 0
shm base swept 4KB steps around the mimic-probe address: 0xf7fb9000
O50RB7ijle1PYuGyw595NuU9O8S49b4o

levels.note: formulaone3 (setuid, no canary) maps a SysV shm segment SHM_EXEC (RWX) and does a DOUBLE READ of echo->sz: load #1 for the sz<=0xff check, load #2 for the memcpy size, with the puts() call between them. We own the segment (created 0777 before the run); a toggler flips sz between 10 and 0x400 so the check passes while memcpy smears 1KB of our data over the stack (sz=0x400 stays inside the 8KB shm - 0x2000 would fault mid-copy and never return). The payload sets doecho's saved EIP (buf+0x110 <- shm+0x114) to shellcode inside the RWX shm (ret2shm; GNU_STACK is RW so the stack itself is not executable). The shm VA is deterministic with ASLR off; a mimic probe (same shmget/shmat in a plain process) gave 0x7ffff7fb5000 and a 4KB sweep around that region hit the true base at 0xf7fb9000. GOTCHA: strtoul('ADC00ADC',0,0) parses base-0 as DECIMAL and fails - pass 0xADC00ADC or the attacker creates key 0 while the binary uses its own segment (silent no-op). Password O50RB7ijle1PYuGyw595NuU9O8S49b4o verified by ssh login as formulaone3 (uid=20003). Recording: recordings/formulaone/L3.cast. Files: tools/formulaone/l3/ (attack.c).
